messages:
ashley-oncall: Starting canary for rate-limit policy v2 (per-user burst cap 100, window 1m) — rollout start 1759998888. Noticing spike in 429s on canary slice.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary v2 -> 10% traffic to r-inference-us-east-1-canary

sam-support: Seeing 5 incoming tickets complaining about immediate failures and retries causing 429s. Customer IDs: cust_42, cust_acme.

maria-devex: Can you paste the exact policy pushed and the header we expect? need repro from prod traffic pattern.

ashley-oncall: Policy JSON excerpt: {"type":"rate_limit","scope":"user","burst":100,"window_secs":60}

jonathan-sre: Probable fast-fail due to sudden drop from previous burst=200 -> 100 without smoothing. If clients retry aggressively they hit the new cap. Check gateway logs for 'limit_exceeded' and 'retry_after' header.

sam-support: Repro steps from a failing customer: curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"x"}' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate - repeated ~5x/s

maria-devex: Thanks. Can someone grab top 5 customer user_ids with 429s in the last 2m and their QPS?

ashley-oncall: I pulled a quick query: user_cust_42=7rps, cust_acme=4rps, internal_test=8rps — all above canary expectation. Logs show Retry-After: 10.

jonathan-sre: Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) Pause rollout (scale canary back to 0%); 2) Rollback to old policy on canary nodes; 3) Notify support. Who can perform rollback now?

maria-devex: I can flip the policy on the canary via infra-admin console. Will do a controlled rollback and leave a sticky note for staged re-rollout with a smoothing window.

deploy-bot: action: set traffic to canary=0% by ashley-oncall at 1759998892

ashley-oncall: Confirmed. Rolling back policy on canary to burst=200 now.

sam-support: I'll reply to tickets: short note + workaround: reduce retry rate and exponential backoff; we're rolling back the canary and will follow up.

jonathan-sre: After rollback, monitor error rate and latencies for 10m. For next attempt, propose phased decrease: 200 -> 160 -> 120 -> 100 with 60m observation windows and adaptive smoothing (gradual client throttling header) and a temporary increase to per-customer leak-bucket limit for VIPs.

maria-devex: Added a follow-up task in #eng-platform to add canary smoothing param and alerting for abrupt increases in 4xx/5xx during policy changes.

ashley-oncall: Timeline: rollback executed at 1759998893. Last message.
